gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-noto-serif-jp: Noto Serif JP has a literary, mellow swing from thick to thin. Happy Monkey sits above it with a ruler-straight line and a level beat, which is the quality that stands out most.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-noto-serif-kr: Happy Monkey draws its bold display letters with a pen line that holds one width throughout. Noto Serif KR follows with a light touch of stroke modulation and wide, barely curled s curves, so the page moves from blunt to gently shaded.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-noto-serif-sc: Noto Serif SC gives you rounded letters that thicken slightly at the sides, with openings you can see through. Happy Monkey is best at a bold, single-depth cut like an engraver's, and the body is best at a mild, pen-like variation in weight.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-noto-serif-tc: Bold, spaghetti-straight lettering up top, wide gaps and all. And Noto Serif TC carries a longer passage with a light modulation, stems barely heavier than their arms, so the lines feel held open and traditional.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-petrona: Loud, bold letters with joins as slim as a pipe cleaner meet a dignified editorial body. And Petrona's small but steady stroke difference is the quality that keeps the pair from jolting or flattening.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-poly: Bookish is the mood the body sets, against a heading that looks cut from strips of equal width. Poly is best at a moderate thick-thin ratio with terminals pulled back from the curves, while Happy Monkey is best at bold, distinctive display lines.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-quattrocento: Classic and traditional in the body, where horizontal strokes run slightly slimmer than the verticals and light shows inside every curve, against a heading drawn like spaghetti. Enlarge Quattrocento a touch.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-radley: Bold lines that keep their width through every turn. Radley, authoritative and dignified, reads across a longer stretch with sturdy hairlines and a comfortable contrast between robust downstrokes and slender turns, letting the eye slip in and out of its counters.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-roboto-serif: Dignified is the mood of Roboto Serif, with big open eyes on every e and a and subtle but visible stroke modulation. But Happy Monkey does its best work in bold letters that never thicken or thin.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-sahitya: Happy Monkey's plain, unmodulated outline gives its bold display letters a distinctive, level look, against a bookish body with medium-low contrast. Shrink the heading and that boldness fades.
